title: Pure-section uniqueness of the first Roos tensor coordinate
statement: For a prime l, a finite extension E/Q_l, a scheme W and a normalized Tensor l E W [def-sf-tensor-completion-comparison], every Augmentation a [def-sf-open-tensor-quotient-data] on any pair P,Q of unbounded completed-coefficient complexes satisfies RoosNormalization: at every finite quotient level and cochain degree, its map equals the first coordinate of the specified tensor-completion chain map.

source.place: Tag 0GL1, unbounded total tensor comparison; the first Roos coordinate is the scalar-unit normalization of Bhatt--Scholze Definition 3.4.10, retained in Tensor.canonical.

proof.text: Maps out of the signed total tensor are determined on each homogeneous direct-sum summand. Tensor and sheafification extensionality reduce equality there to pure sections. The sections field of a and the first clause of Tensor.canonical give the same value, namely the total tensor of the two scalar-unit sections. Thus the chain maps agree at each quotient level, and evaluating in every cochain degree gives the required HEq. The proof works for arbitrary, zero, and unbounded complexes.
